findings.statement: LuxPlanes 00:26 short “Why Are Airplane Windows Round?” showed 376,625 views and 11,834 likes on its public page at audit time (E6AUYtJwiLs).
Crayon Monkey Workshop 07:57 demonstration “Why aircraft have round windows…” showed 5,522 views and a physical paper/metal stress demonstration (hrHw4oxeBzE).
Anand Vyas 03:20 paperclip fatigue demo showed 5,189 views; transcript states a wire tolerates ~50 N statically but fails under repeated lower force (CvHX7l5nPj4).
CarAraC 04:40 “Why Car Parts Break Without Warning — Metal Fatigue” showed 223 views and describes microcracks starting at corners, welds and corrosion (J2jG0-dwXTU).
Hook formula extracted from multiple transcripts: “You never noticed X / it was not always X / then something terrifying happened”, then a shape-mechanism payoff.
A 00:52 ice+salt can experiment from SCIENCE KITCHEN LAB showed 3,098 views; a gecko setae video showed 2,732 views; a retroreflector compliance video showed 381 views (s4,s5,s8).
Adjacent-format signal: RHCB 03:01 “1000°C Red Hot Metal Ball vs Ice, Coca-Cola & Popcorn!” showed 3,144,190 views — extreme-heat satisfying destruction travels far beyond science niches (s9).
Proposed 3D stress-concentration cutaway is an illustrative model, not a finite-element result; no test or render has been run.
outlier_multiple is unavailable: the official-API workflow could not be dispatched (HTTP 403), and channel upload medians could not be fetched from public pages.
Thumbnail visual audit (Claws Vision) could not be performed: i.ytimg.com is unreachable from the sandbox and image search returned unrelated images.

gaps: No API-derived outlier_multiple; all candidate videos are unverified on the 10-surrounding-upload metric.
No contact sheet / visual inspection of competitor thumbnails; only titles, dimensions and descriptions were observed.
No comment mining; transcripts came from fetched public video pages only.
Channel subscriber counts were not available from public video pages, so max_subs gate was not applied.
Historical aviation failure references must stay educational and gore-free; no crash footage is to be reused.
Owner selection not recorded — scorecard must remain not-yet, never production-candidate.
